limitations: L4 is offline synthetic software acceptance, never biological, physical or clinical validation.
Hash-bound declarations cannot prove historical freeze timing, true organism identity, collection fitness or independent sources.
The fixed selection rule admits exactly upstream selected flags; directional lists are nonempty up and down lists. Full-universe or empty selected lists are refused.
BH covers all tested set/list pairs together; size-excluded sets remain untested. Connected significant sets form one dependent finding.
The single synthetic study cannot establish replication; independent review remains coordinator-owned and unavailable here.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. The gate also refuses truth, physical validity and patient benefit, includes negations and is incomplete for unlisted paraphrases.
Absent or unavailable cited records require unavailable claims; review approval and computed agreement cannot support positive claims.
Raw files are bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB across distinct inodes and a conservative 4000000-value bundle allowance before JSON allocation. No stored records change validation.
